title: ios-acceptance-record
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-record build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.constructor.print
inputs.description: Function that receives the lines emitted by begin and check. It matters when capturing or redirecting output; when omitted, it defaults to console.log.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.begin.phase
inputs.description: Current phase label assigned before later checks are recorded. It matters because each check stores this value; begin also prints it as a heading.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.hide.secret
inputs.description: Sensitive string added to the record’s redaction inputs. It matters when safe processes text later; hide itself does not print it.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.safe.text
inputs.description: Text passed with secrets previously supplied to hide to redacted. It matters when returning text intended for safe printing or writing; filtering details are delegated to redacted.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.check.passed
inputs.description: Any value converted with Boolean(...) to determine the check’s passed flag. It matters when recording an assertion; truthy values count as passed and falsy values count as failed.
inputs.unknownReason: This recorder accepts any assertion result and records its JavaScript truthiness.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.check.name
inputs.description: Name label processed through safe before it is stored and printed. It matters when recording an assertion; the saved and emitted name is the processed text.

inputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.stopped.error
inputs.description: Value passed to errorMessage when a phase cannot continue. The first line of its resulting message, capped at 240 characters, is embedded in the failed check name.
inputs.unknownReason: A failed phase may supply any thrown value; the recorder formats it into a short diagnostic.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.begin
outputs.description: No value is returned. It sets the current phase and emits a blank-line-prefixed phase heading through the configured print callback.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.hide
outputs.description: No value is returned. It appends the supplied secret to the redaction list for later safe text processing.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.safe
outputs.description: String produced by redacted from the supplied text and stored secrets. It is used when a caller needs sanitized text; exact substitutions are delegated to redacted.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.check
outputs.description: No value is returned. It records the current phase, safe-processed name, and Boolean-converted result, then emits an ok or FAIL line.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.stopped
outputs.description: No value is returned. It records a failed check whose name starts with “the phase stopped:” and includes only the first line of the reason, truncated to 240 characters.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.failed
outputs.description: Number of recorded checks whose passed flag is false. It matters when reading the record’s failure count; it is recalculated from checks on access.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.passed
outputs.description: Number of recorded checks minus the failed count. It matters when reading the record’s pass count; it is recalculated from checks on access.

outputs.name: AcceptanceRecord.constructor
outputs.description: New AcceptanceRecord instance with empty checks and secrets and an empty current phase. The instance retains the supplied print callback, or console.log when the callback is omitted.
